inquiry_threshold.description: Deferred-asset level above which Congress opens an inquiry (same units as deferred_asset).

political_capital_drain.description: Political capital deducted each month the deferred asset exceeds the threshold.

independence_drain.description: Independence points deducted each month above threshold (clamped to [0,100]).

initial_independence.description: Default independence when absent from state (fiscal-dominance axis, in [0,100]).
